description: This file defines the RDKShell class, which serves as a plugin interface for managing application windows, input handling, events, and system resources within a larger embedded or media system framework. It contains class declarations, method signatures, event identifiers, and data structures used for controlling and monitoring shell-based applications, as well as handling events like application lifecycle, input, and system warnings.

classes.description: Main plugin class providing application and system shell management, event handling, input intercepts, and resource controls.
